name: app-gantt-style-scope-of-work-pills-with-blue-duration-tags
title: Month-column scope slide with six white pills staggered diagonally, each with a blue week-duration tag
whatItIs: A warm grey rounded panel 'Scope of work' with month labels (Sep to Jan) over thin vertical lines and six white pill bars (Research, Ideation, Wireframes, Branding, Prototype & testing, UI design) offset along the months, each ending in a blue capsule with its duration.
whatItMeans: Clear and friendly; the pills turn a project plan into a readable staircase.
techniques: Lay pills across month columns as a Gantt.
Put duration in a blue capsule.

vocabulary.definition: A schedule shown with rounded bars.
A vertical band labelled with a month.
